title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5** and **Claude Mythos 5** — marking the introduction of a new capability tier above Opus. Fable 5 is the first Mythos-class model cleared for general public access. Mythos 5 is the same underlying model with fewer safeguards, made available only to a restricted group of cyber defenders and critical infrastructure providers.

---

## A New Tier Above Opus

The Haiku / Sonnet / Opus naming convention that has structured Claude's model family since Claude 3 (March 2024) gains a fourth tier:

| Tier | Representative Model | Positioning |
|------|---------------------|-------------|
| Haiku | claude-haiku-4-5 | Fast, cheapest |
| Sonnet | claude-sonnet-4-6 | Balanced |
| Opus | claude-opus-4-8 | Most capable (standard) |
| **Fable / Mythos** | **claude-fable-5** | **Frontier research-grade** |

The Fable tier represents capabilities beyond what Anthropic has previously made generally accessible. The model ID is `claude-fable-5`.

---

## Capabilities & Benchmarks

Fable 5 is state-of-the-art on nearly all tested benchmarks at release, with exceptional performance across:

- **Software engineering:** 80.3% on SWE-Bench Pro — 11 percentage points ahead of the next-best model
- **Knowledge work:** Top scores across MMLU and domain-specific professional benchmarks
- **Vision:** Strong multimodal understanding including charts, diagrams, and complex visual reasoning
- **Scientific research:** Competitive performance on GPQA (graduate-level scientific questions)
- **Long-horizon agentic tasks:** When given persistent file-based memory in a game environment (Slay the Spire), Fable 5 improved 3× more than Opus 4.8 and reached the final act 3× as often, suggesting significantly better strategic planning over extended sessions

---

## Fable vs. Mythos: Two Variants

Anthropic ships the same underlying model in two configurations:

**Claude Fable 5** (general availability)
- Available via API, Claude.ai, Bedrock, and Vertex AI
- Includes safeguards: certain high-risk queries are automatically re-routed to Claude Opus 4.8
- Suitable for software engineering, research, document analysis, agentic pipelines

**Claude Mythos 5** (restricted access)
- Reduced safeguards, enabling capabilities useful for offensive security research and critical infrastructure analysis
- Access limited to vetted cyber defenders, security researchers, and infrastructure providers
- Not available via the standard API

This two-variant approach lets Anthropic deploy Mythos-class capabilities broadly while retaining a higher-safety configuration as the default.

---

## API Access

Fable 5 is available on the Anthropic API with the model ID `claude-fable-5`. It is also available on:
- **Amazon Bedrock** (as of the launch announcement)
- **Google Cloud Vertex AI**
- **Claude Code** (via model selection settings)

Fable 5 carries the highest per-token cost in the Claude lineup. For workloads where its top-tier capability isn't necessary, Opus 4.8 remains the recommended default.

---

## Context and Implications

Fable 5's release completes a pattern visible across Claude generations: each new frontier capability eventually becomes general access. Computer use debuted in restricted beta in late 2024; extended thinking followed a similar path. The Mythos-class capability set, first developed internally, is now broadly available via Fable 5.

The SWE-Bench Pro result (80.3%) is particularly significant for agentic coding workloads — it implies Fable 5 can autonomously resolve a larger fraction of real-world GitHub issues than any previously available model.
